name: Prow Z
summary:
Survive in a world full of zombies. PROW Z Open world zombie game

"Get ready to survive in a world devastated by zombies in "PROW Z"!

Explore a vast open world filled with zombie-filled cities, towns, and fields. Face endless hordes of undead as you search for vital resources and equipment to survive. Every corner of this abandoned world contains unique dangers and challenges.
